business_question: Can process anomalies, yield shifts, and defect risk be detected using process logs while preserving time, lot, equipment, and recipe structure for offline manufacturing decision support?

included: equipment, line, lot, batch, product, recipe, and time-unit analysis
offline defect or yield risk estimation
limited what-if or virtual screening as a screening aid

bosch_production_line_performance.name: Bosch Production Line Performance
bosch_production_line_performance.rationale: Strong potential fit because public descriptions indicate production-line structure with numeric, categorical, and date-style manufacturing measurements plus a downstream failure target.

uci_secom.name: UCI SECOM
uci_secom.rationale: Semiconductor manufacturing process measurements with timestamp and pass/fail label. It is smaller and has weaker equipment/lot structure than Bosch, but public license clarity is stronger.

uci_ai4i_2020_predictive_maintenance.name: UCI AI4I 2020 Predictive Maintenance
uci_ai4i_2020_predictive_maintenance.rationale: Useful for readiness tests and synthetic process examples. It does not replace real-world validation evidence.

tennessee_eastman_process_dataset.name: Tennessee Eastman process dataset
tennessee_eastman_process_dataset.rationale: Useful for process-control, drift, anomaly, and SPC demonstrations. It does not replace real-world validation evidence.

uci_steel_plates_faults.name: UCI Steel Plates Faults
uci_steel_plates_faults.rationale: Useful quality-classification data, but it lacks the time, equipment, lot, and process-log structure required for the v1.4 primary process-quality case.

status_transition_policy.promotion_rule: Bosch can be promoted to active_primary only after v1.4.2 verifies access, competition terms, license/redistribution scope, file inventory, schema, and readiness gates.
status_transition_policy.failure_rule: If access, terms, or schema verification fails, mark the candidate blocked or rejected and activate the SECOM fallback path.

unit_of_analysis.definition: One produced unit, inspected part, wafer, cycle, batch observation, or process observation that can be joined to process context and downstream quality.

prediction_horizon.definition: The time or process step boundary between observable process data and downstream quality outcome.

observation_timestamp.definition: Timestamp or ordered run index available before the quality outcome.

quality_measurement_timestamp.definition: Timestamp when inspection, test, or quality measurement became available.

equipment_id.definition: Machine, station, chamber, tool, or equipment identifier.

line_id.definition: Production line or manufacturing route identifier.

lot_id.definition: Lot identifier for group-aware validation and leakage control.

product_id.definition: Product, part number, material grade, or recipe family identifier.

recipe_id.definition: Recipe, program, setpoint family, or process condition label.

operator_id.definition: Operator identifier. Use as metadata only unless privacy review and role policy allow analysis.
operator_id.policy: Do not use as a predictive feature by default. Avoid personal-data exposure in tracked artifacts.

quality_target_families.name: pass_fail
quality_target_families.definition: Binary quality outcome such as pass, fail, defect, or machine failure.

quality_target_families.name: defect_count_or_rate
quality_target_families.definition: Count, rate, or proportion of nonconforming units.

quality_target_families.name: continuous_quality_measurement
quality_target_families.definition: Measured dimension, strength, purity, resistance, or other quality property.

quality_target_families.name: rework_or_scrap
quality_target_families.definition: Post-inspection disposition; metadata only unless explicitly modeled as an outcome.

defect_flag.definition: 1 when downstream inspection indicates defect or failure, 0 otherwise.

yield_percent.definition: Good units divided by total units times 100, using only observations whose denominator is known.

defect_rate.definition: Defect count divided by inspected count for a defined unit, lot, batch, or time window.

censoring_delayed_quality.rule: Rows without matured quality outcomes must be labeled as pending or censored rather than treated as pass.

missingness.rule: Report missingness by column and keep imputation train-only inside validation folds.

duplicates.rule: Report exact-row and key-based duplicates. Do not silently drop repeated measurements.

outliers.rule: Flag implausible values for review. Do not remove production excursions without documented criteria.

temporal_ordering.rule: Sort by observation time or stable run order before time-aware validation.

group_split.rule: Use lot, batch, equipment, product, or recipe groups when available. Random split is only an optimistic reference.

time_split.rule: Use forward chronological or blocked time splits for primary evidence when timestamps are present.

leakage.rule: Exclude post-outcome fields, future windows, target-derived aggregates, and identifiers that directly encode target timing.

train_only_preprocessing.rule: Fit scalers, imputers, encoders, target encoders, and thresholds on training folds only.

privacy.rule: Do not track credentials, operator personal data, private paths, or raw production exports.

requirements: baseline period defined without future leakage
consistent subgroup size or documented handling
attribute defect count or defect rate

control_limit_policy.rule: Control limits must be learned from baseline periods only and are distinct from engineering specification limits.

requirements: externally provided lower or upper specification limits

specification_limit_policy.rule: Do not invent specification limits for real datasets. Synthetic fixtures may define known limits explicitly.

requirements: process variable distributions by time block

allowed_claims: descriptive SPC and capability readiness review
stop_conditions: No legally usable public source can be identified.
No downstream quality outcome is available.
No time or order field exists.
No meaningful group structure exists for validation.
Target is only available through leakage fields.
Dataset is too small for any group-aware or time-aware validation.
License or redistribution terms are ambiguous.
Process-quality unit of analysis cannot be identified.
